findings.text: issue (blocking): The live-HEAD preflight check and the pre-executable snapshot are separate reads. If HEAD moves between them, package tests and adversarial probes still start; the later recompute blocks the push, but REQ-1's no-execution guarantee is violated.
findings.fix: Use the same HEAD read for preflight validation and the before-probes snapshot, or recompare the snapshot with head_sha before either executable; add a regression test that moves HEAD between the reads and asserts zero executable starts.
